tools.name: sprucehealth_get_organization
tools.description: Your Spruce organization (id and name). The id is the owner/member id used by other objects. Good first call. GET /organization.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_members
tools.description: All members of the organization: teammates (name, email, admin, suspended), teams and the organization itself. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /organization/members.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_member
tools.description: One organization member (teammate, team or the organization) by id. GET /organization/members/{memberId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_team_members
tools.description: The members of one team (team ids come from sprucehealth_list_members, type 'team'). Paged. GET /teams/{teamId}/members.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contacts
tools.description: Contacts of the organization (patients, professionals, clinics): name, date of birth, phones, emails, tags, custom fields, integration links. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. Use sprucehealth_search_contacts to find someone. GET /contacts.

tools.name: sprucehealth_search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by free text and/or filters (category, tags, name, phone, email, invite state, created time). Filters combine with AND; values inside one filter match ANY (tags can use all/none). Paged; totalCount with totalCountRelation (eq = exact, gte = lower bound). A read: POST /contacts/search c

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by Spruce contact id (entity_…): demographics, phones, emails, tags, custom and organization fields, integration links. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations
tools.description: The conversations (secure, SMS/phone, email, fax…) associated with one contact. GET /contacts/{contactId}/conversations.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links
tools.description: Links between a contact and external systems (Elation, Hint, athena, custom): type, external id, url. GET /contacts/{contactId}/integrationlinks.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_tags
tools.description: All contact tags of the organization. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /contacts/tags.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_contact_fields
tools.description: The organization-wide contact fields shown on every contact. Paged; totalCount included. GET /contacts/fields.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversations
tools.description: Conversations of the organization (title, type, tags, archived, assignee, participants, last message time), ordered by creation or last message. With start_from, only conversations whose ordering time is at or after it (useful for 'what changed since…'). Eventually consistent. Paged; give start_from

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_conversation
tools.description: One conversation by id (t_…). GET /conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_items
tools.description: The items (messages, internal notes, calls, voicemails, faxes, attachments with short-lived signed URLs) in one conversation. Order newest_first (default) or oldest_first; start_from = only items created after that time. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount is a best-effort count. GET /con

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_conversation_item
tools.description: One conversation item (message, note, call, voicemail…) by id (ti_…). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_read_receipts
tools.description: Who has read one conversation item and when they first read it (oldest first). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}/readReceipts.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_transcription
tools.description: The full transcription text and its summary (if any) for a transcription id (the transcriptionId on a call/voicemail attachment). Status pending/completed/failed/noSpeech. GET /transcriptions/{transcriptionId}.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_tags
tools.description: All conversation tags of the organization. Paged; totalCount included. GET /conversations/tags.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_conversation_scheduled_messages
tools.description: Messages scheduled to be sent later in one conversation (read only; nothing is sent or cancelled). GET /conversations/{conversationId}/scheduledmessages.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_scheduled_messages
tools.description: All messages scheduled to be sent from the organization (read only). Paged with hasMore/paginationToken; totalCount included. GET /scheduledmessages.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_saved_messages
tools.description: Saved message templates (private and organization-wide): title, text, internal/shared flags. Paged with hasMore/paginationToken. GET /savedmessages.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_internal_endpoints
tools.description: The organization's own channels: Spruce phone and fax numbers, email addresses and Spruce Links, with their owner and members. GET /internalendpoints.

tools.name: sprucehealth_list_phone_lines
tools.description: All phone lines of the organization (id, name); totalCount included. GET /phonelines.

tools.name: sprucehealth_get_phone_line
tools.description: One phone line by id (pd_…). GET /phonelines/{phonelineId}.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sprucehealth_list_read_receipts" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Who has read one conversation item and when they first read it (oldest first). GET /conversationItems/{conversationItemId}/readReceipts.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sprucehealth_list_members, sprucehealth_list_contacts, sprucehealth_search_contacts, sprucehealth_get_contact, sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations, sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links, sprucehealth_list_conversations, sprucehealth_list_conversation_items, sprucehealth_get_conversation_item, sprucehealth_list_conversation_scheduled_messages, sprucehealth_list_scheduled_messages, sprucehealth_list_saved_messages, sprucehealth_list_internal_endpoints · Private data: sprucehealth_list_contacts, sprucehealth_search_contacts, sprucehealth_get_contact, sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations, sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links, sprucehealth_list_contact_tags, sprucehealth_list_contact_fields, sprucehealth_list_saved_messages · Public sink: sprucehealth_list_members, sprucehealth_search_contacts, sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations, sprucehealth_list_internal_endpoints.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sprucehealth_list_members, sprucehealth_list_contacts, sprucehealth_search_contacts, sprucehealth_get_contact, sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations, sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links, sprucehealth_list_conversations, sprucehealth_list_conversation_items, sprucehealth_get_conversation_item, sprucehealth_list_conversation_scheduled_messages, sprucehealth_list_scheduled_messages, sprucehealth_list_saved_messages, sprucehealth_list_internal_endpoints · Private data: sprucehealth_list_contacts, sprucehealth_search_contacts, sprucehealth_get_contact, sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations, sprucehealth_list_contact_integration_links, sprucehealth_list_contact_tags, sprucehealth_list_contact_fields, sprucehealth_list_saved_messages · Public sink: sprucehealth_list_members, sprucehealth_search_contacts, sprucehealth_list_contact_conversations, sprucehealth_list_internal_endpoints

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
